en.t: Theodosian Code published by imperial constitution
en.s: On 15 February 438, the Theodosian Code was published by an imperial constitution. The compilation gathered laws issued by Christian Roman emperors and came into force on January1,439.
en.n: This is publication of the code, not the start of compilation in429 or its entry into force in439.

zh.s: 438年2月15日，《狄奥多西法典》通过皇帝敕令颁布。这部法典汇集了信奉基督教的罗马皇帝所颁法律，于439年1月1日生效。
zh.n: 此条记录法典的颁布，区别于429年开始编纂及439年生效。

en.t: Arduin acclaimed king of Italy at Pavia
en.s: On 15 February 1002, an assembly of nobles at Pavia, in present-day Italy, acclaimed Arduin king of Italy after Emperor Otto III’s death. He was crowned at Pavia’s Basilica of San Michele Maggiore.

zh.t: 阿尔杜因在帕维亚被拥立为意大利国王
zh.s: 1002年2月15日，皇帝奥托三世去世后，贵族在今意大利帕维亚集会，拥立阿尔杜因为意大利国王。他在帕维亚圣米凯莱大教堂加冕。

en.t: King John lands his army at La Rochelle
en.s: On 15 February 1214, King John of England landed with his army at La Rochelle, in present-day France, after sailing from Portsmouth. The landing opened his campaign to recover continental possessions.

zh.t: 英王约翰率军在拉罗谢尔登陆
zh.s: 1214年2月15日，英格兰国王约翰率军从朴次茅斯出航后，在今法国拉罗谢尔登陆，展开收复欧洲大陆领地的军事行动。

en.t: Columbus’s first-voyage letter bears a February15 date
en.s: A letter announcing Christopher Columbus’s first Atlantic voyage bears the date 15 February 1493 in its printed versions. It described the lands he had reached; a postscript was added at Lisbon on March4. The exact place and circumstances of drafting are disputed.
en.n: This records the date carried by the printed letter; it does not resolve its disputed drafting location or treat the March4 postscript as February15.

zh.t: 哥伦布首次航行信件署有2月15日的日期
zh.s: 哥伦布介绍首次横渡大西洋航行的信件，在印刷版本中署有1493年2月15日的日期。信中描述了他抵达的土地，3月4日又在里斯本补写附言。信件最初写于何处、如何成稿，仍有争议。
zh.n: 此条记录印刷信件所署日期，不据此确定有争议的成稿地点，也不将3月4日的附言算作2月15日所写。

en.s: The siege of Polotsk was the siege of the Lithuanian fortress of Polotsk that took place in the winter of 1562 and 1563. The siege is considered one of the largest campaigns of the Russian army in the 16th century. The fall of the city caused a resonance throughout Europe and raised the prestige of the Russian tsar.

en.t: Ferdinand III succeeds as Holy Roman Emperor

en.s: The March Across the Belts (Swedish: Tåget över Bält) was a military campaign waged by the Swedish Empire across the ice between the Danish islands. It lasted between 30 January and 15 February 1658, ending with a decisive victory for Swedish King Charles X Gustav during his first Danish war. On 5 June 1657, Denmark declared war on Sweden which was under heavy pressure in the Second Northern War against Poland and Russia.

en.s: The Siege of Kimberley took place during the Second Boer War at Kimberley, Cape Colony (present-day South Africa), when Boer forces from the Orange Free State and the Transvaal besieged the diamond mining town. The Boers moved quickly to try to capture the British enclave when war broke out between the British and the two Boer republics in October 1899. The town was ill-prepared, but the defenders organised an energetic and effective improvised defence that was able to prevent it from being taken. Cecil Rhodes, who had made his fortune in the town, and who controlled all the mining activities, moved into the town at the onset of the siege. His presence was controversial, as his involvement in the Jameson Raid made him one of the primary protagonists behind war breaking out. Rhodes was constantly at loggerheads with the military, but he was nonetheless instrumental in organising the defence of the town. The Boers shelled the town with their superior artillery in an attempt to force the garrison to capitulate. Engineers of the De Beers company manufactured a one-off gun named Long Cecil, however the Boers soon countered with a much larger siege gun that terrified the residents, forcing many to take shelter in the Kimberley Mine. The British military had to change its strategy for the war as public opinion demanded that the sieges of Kimberley, Ladysmith and Mafeking be relieved before the Boer capitals were assaulted. The first attempt at relief of Kimberley under Lord Methuen was stopped at the battles of Modder River and Magersfontein. The 124-day siege was finally relieved on 15 February 1900 by a cavalry division under Lieutenant-General John French, part of a larger force under Lord Roberts.

zh.s: 第二次布尔战争期间，奥兰治自由邦和德兰士瓦的布尔军队围攻开普殖民地的金伯利钻石矿镇（今属南非）。1899年10月英国与两个布尔共和国开战后，布尔军队迅速行动，试图夺取这座英国据点。金伯利防守准备不足，但守军组织了积极有效的临时防御，挡住了进攻。塞西尔·罗得斯靠当地采矿业致富并控制了矿业活动，围城开始时他也进入镇内。他因参与詹姆森突袭而被视为战争爆发的主要推手之一，因此他的出现颇具争议。罗得斯与军方时常发生冲突，但仍在组织防御方面发挥了重要作用。布尔军队凭借火炮优势炮击该镇，试图迫使守军投降。戴比尔斯公司的工程师制造了一门名为“长塞西尔”的特制火炮，但布尔军队很快以更大的攻城炮还击，吓得许多居民躲进金伯利矿井。随着公众要求先解救金伯利、莱迪史密斯和马弗京的围城，英国军方不得不改变作战策略，暂缓进攻布尔共和国首都。梅休因勋爵率军首次尝试解围，在莫德河战役和马格斯方丹战役中受阻。围城持续124天，最终于1900年2月15日由约翰·弗伦奇中将率领的骑兵师解围；该部队隶属罗伯茨勋爵统率的一支更大部队。

en.s: The Upton train ambush took place on 15 February 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. The Irish Republican Army (IRA) mounted an attack on a train carrying British soldiers at Upton, County Cork. The action was a disaster for the IRA; three of its volunteers were killed and two wounded. Six British soldiers were wounded, three seriously. Six civilian passengers were killed and ten wounded in the crossfire.

en.t: Attempted assassination of Franklin D. Roosevelt
en.s: On February 15, 1933, Franklin D. Roosevelt, then president-elect of the United States, survived an assassination attempt while delivering an impromptu speech at night from the back of an open car in Miami, Florida. en.s: The Battle of Monte Cassino, also known as the Battle for Rome, was a series of four military assaults by the Allies against Axis forces in Italy during the Italian Campaign of World War II. The objective was to break through the Winter Line and facilitate an advance towards Rome. In the beginning of 1944, the western half of the Winter Line was anchored by German forces holding the Rapido-Gari, Liri, and Garigliano valleys and several surrounding peaks and ridges. Together, these features formed the Gustav Line. Monte Cassino, a historic hilltop abbey founded in 529 by Benedict of Nursia, dominated the nearby town of Cassino and the entrances to the Liri and Rapido valleys. Lying in a protected historic zone, it had been left unoccupied by the Germans, although they manned some positions set into the slopes below the abbey's walls. Repeated artillery attacks on assaulting allied troops caused their leaders to incorrectly conclude that the abbey was being used by the Germans as an observation post, at the very least. Fears escalated, along with casualties, and despite evidence, it was marked for destruction. On 15 February 1944, Allied bombers dropped 1,400 tonnes of high explosives, causing widespread damage.

zh.s: 卡西诺山战役又称罗马争夺战，是二战意大利战役期间，盟军对轴心国军队进行的四次军事进攻，旨在突破冬季防线，向罗马推进。1944年初，德军据守拉皮多—加里河谷、利里河谷、加里利亚诺河谷及附近山峰山脊，构成冬季防线西半部的古斯塔夫防线。卡西诺山修道院由努尔西亚的本笃于529年建立，居高临下俯瞰卡西诺镇及利里和拉皮多河谷入口。因位于受保护的历史区域，德军并未占领修道院，只在院墙下方山坡设置阵地。盟军进攻部队屡遭炮击，使指挥官误以为德军至少将修道院用作观察哨。随着伤亡增加，担忧加深，即使已有相反证据，修道院仍被列为轰炸目标。1944年2月15日，盟军轰炸机投下1400吨高爆炸药，造成大规模破坏。

zh.s: 1967年2月15日，印度马哈拉施特拉邦第107选区举行邦议会投票。春尼拉尔·辛格获宣布当选，此后其当选结果引发诉讼，案件上诉至印度最高法院。
zh.n: 这是第107选区的投票日期，并非全邦统一的投票日期。

en.t: Lucknow Cantonment holds its Uttar Pradesh assembly poll
en.s: On February 15, 1967, Lucknow Cantonment constituency voted in Uttar Pradesh’s legislative assembly election in India. Eleven candidates contested the seat; the result was declared on February 23.
en.n: This is the polling date for Lucknow Cantonment constituency, rather than a single polling day for all of Uttar Pradesh.

zh.t: 勒克瑙军营选区举行北方邦议会投票
zh.s: 1967年2月15日，印度北方邦勒克瑙军营选区举行邦议会投票，十一名候选人争夺这个议席，结果于2月23日公布。
zh.n: 这是勒克瑙军营选区的投票日期，并非北方邦全邦统一的投票日期。

en.s: On February 15, 1970, Dominicana de Aviación Flight 603, en route from Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic to San Juan, Puerto Rico crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after takeoff. The crash killed all 97 passengers and 5 crew on board, making it the deadliest aviation disaster to occur within the Dominican Republic until the crash of Birgenair Flight 301 in 1996, in the Caribbean Sea, leaving 189 dead.

zh.s: 1970年2月15日，多米尼加航空603号班机从多米尼加共和国圣多明各飞往波多黎各圣胡安，起飞后不久坠入加勒比海。机上97名乘客和5名机组人员全部遇难。在1996年伯根航空301号班机坠毁、造成189人死亡之前，这是多米尼加境内死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.s: El Carnavalazo was a military coup in Ecuador led by Guillermo Rodríguez Lara that deposed the government of José María Velasco Ibarra on 15 February 1972, ending the fifth and last of the Velasquist presidencies. This event was popularly called "Carnavalazo" because it happened during the Ecuadorian carnival.

zh.s: 1972年2月15日，厄瓜多尔发生军事政变，由吉列尔莫·罗德里格斯·拉腊领导的军方推翻何塞·玛丽亚·贝拉斯科·伊瓦拉政府，结束了贝拉斯科第五次、也是最后一次担任总统的任期。当地人把这次事件称为“El Carnavalazo”，因为政变发生在厄瓜多尔狂欢节期间。

en.t: Second Battle of Amgala ends after overnight fighting
en.s: On the night of 14–15 February 1976, Polisario forces attacked Moroccan troops at Amgala in Western Sahara. Moroccan forces lost the position in the fighting remembered as the Second Battle of Amgala.
en.n: February15 is the endpoint of the overnight February14–15 fighting. Western Sahara is a disputed territory; the country/territory label denotes the battle’s location.

zh.t: 第二次阿姆加拉战役结束
zh.s: 1976年2月14日至15日夜间，波利萨里奥阵线部队进攻西撒哈拉阿姆加拉的摩洛哥军队。摩军在这场被称为第二次阿姆加拉战役的战斗中失去该据点。
zh.n: 2月15日为2月14日至15日夜间战斗的结束日期。西撒哈拉是有争议地区，此处标签用于表示战场位置。

en.s: The Battle of N'Djamena in 1979 also called First Battle of N'Djamena was fought between government forces loyal to the President Malloum and FAN rebels led by Prime Minister Habre. After three days of street fighting in N'Djamena, Sudan mediated the conflict between the two parties. After three days of negotiations Malloum and Habre agreed to a ceasefire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1979年的恩贾梅纳之战又称第一次恩贾梅纳之战，交战双方是在总统马卢姆麾下的政府军，以及由总理哈布雷领导的北方武装力量（FAN）叛军。恩贾梅纳街头战斗持续三天后，苏丹出面斡旋。经过三天谈判，马卢姆和哈布雷同意停火。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The drilling rig Ocean Ranger sinks during a storm off the coast of Newfoundland, killing 84 workers
en.s: Ocean Ranger was a semi-submersible mobile oil platform that sank in Canadian waters on 15 February 1982. It was drilling an exploration well on the Grand Banks of Newfoundland, 267 kilometres (166 mi) east of St. John's, Newfoundland, for Mobil Oil of Canada, Ltd. (MOCAN) with 84 crew members on board when it sank. There were no survivors.

zh.t: 海洋游侠号钻井平台风暴中沉没，84名工人遇难
zh.s: 1982年2月15日，海洋游侠号半潜式移动钻井平台在加拿大海域沉没。当时平台正在纽芬兰大浅滩钻探勘探井，地点位于纽芬兰圣约翰斯以东267公里（166英里）处，受加拿大莫比尔石油有限公司委托作业，船上有84名船员。事故无人生还。

en.s: The Afghan Civil War of 1989–1992 (Pashto: له ۱۹۸۹ څخه تر ۱۹۹۲ پوري د افغانستان کورنۍ جګړه), also known as the First Afghan Civil War, took place between the Soviet withdrawal from Afghanistan on 15 February 1989 which ended the Soviet–Afghan War, and 27 April 1992, the day after the proclamation of the Peshawar Accords proclaiming a new interim Afghan government which was supposed to start serving on 28 April 1992.

zh.s: 1989—1992年阿富汗内战又称第一次阿富汗内战，始于1989年2月15日苏军撤离阿富汗、苏阿战争结束之时，持续至1992年4月27日。此前一天公布的《白沙瓦协议》宣布成立新的阿富汗临时政府，计划于4月28日开始执政。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sri Lanka on 15 February 1989, the first since 1977. The elections that should normally have been held by 1983 had been cancelled by the 1982 referendum.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于1989年2月15日举行议会选举，这是1977年以来首次议会选举。按正常安排，本应不迟于1983年举行的选举，因1982年公投而被取消。

en.t: Soviet troops complete their withdrawal from Afghanistan
en.s: On 15 February 1989, the last Soviet troops left Afghanistan under the withdrawal timetable agreed in the1988 Geneva Accords. Their departure ended the Soviet military intervention, while fighting within Afghanistan continued.

zh.t: 苏军完成从阿富汗撤军
zh.s: 1989年2月15日，最后一批苏军按照1988年日内瓦协议确定的时间表撤离阿富汗。苏军的军事干预由此结束，但阿富汗内部的战争仍在继续。

en.t: Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Poland establish Visegrád cooperation
en.s: On 15 February 1991, the leaders of Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Poland met at Visegrád, Hungary, and established a cooperation group to support democratic change and European integration.

zh.t: 捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利与波兰建立维谢格拉德合作机制
zh.s: 1991年2月15日，捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利和波兰领导人在匈牙利维谢格拉德会晤，建立合作机制，推动民主转型与欧洲一体化。

en.s: The Tamaki by-election 1992 was a by-election held in the Tāmaki electorate during the 43rd New Zealand Parliament, on 15 February 1992. It was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP Sir Robert Muldoon and was won by Clem Simich with a majority of 1,252. The by-election was also notable as the first contested by the recently formed Alliance Party, and for their success in coming second ahead of the Labour Party.

zh.s: 新西兰第43届议会任内，塔马基选区于1992年2月15日举行补选。现任议员罗伯特·马尔登爵士辞职，议席因此出缺。克莱姆·西米奇以1252票优势获胜。新成立的联盟党首次参选，并超越工党取得第二名，也是此次补选的突出结果。

en.s: Air Transport International Flight 805 was a regularly scheduled domestic cargo flight from Seattle to Toledo operated by Burlington Air Express. On February 15, 1992, the Douglas DC-8 operating the flight crashed during a second go-around attempt at Toledo Express Airport, killing all four people on board. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) determined that the accident was caused by pilot error due to the aircraft's control not being maintained.

zh.t: 国际航空运输805号班机空难
zh.s: 国际航空运输805号班机是伯灵顿航空快递运营、从西雅图飞往托莱多的定期国内货运航班。1992年2月15日，执行航班的道格拉斯DC-8在托莱多快运机场第二次尝试复飞时坠毁，机上四人全部遇难。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，事故由飞行员操作失误、未能保持飞机操纵所致。

en.s: Elections to the 1992 Australian Capital Territory Legislative Assembly was held on Saturday, 15 February, alongside a referendum on electoral change for future elections. The incumbent Labor Party, led by Rosemary Follett, was challenged by the Liberal Party, led by Trevor Kaine. Candidates were elected to fill seats using list proportional representation (the modified d'Hondt electoral system) and a multi-member at-large constituency.

zh.s: 1992年2月15日，澳大利亚首都领地举行立法议会选举，并就未来选举制度改革举行公投。在任工党由罗丝玛丽·福利特领导，自由党则由特雷弗·凯恩领导。议席采用名单比例代表制（经调整的汉狄法），在全领地的多议员选区中选出。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia between 26 January and 15 February 1993. Michal Kováč was elected as the first president of Slovakia and became the only Slovak president elected by Parliament.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于1993年1月26日至2月15日举行总统选举。米哈尔·科瓦奇当选首任总统，也成为斯洛伐克唯一一位由议会选出的总统。

en.s: The 1993 Tripura Legislative Assembly election took place in a single phase on 15 February 1993 to elect the Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from each of the 60 Assembly Constituencies (ACs) in Tripura, India.

zh.s: 印度特里普拉邦于1993年2月15日一次性举行邦议会选举，在全部60个选区选出议员。

en.s: On 15 February 1993, voters in Nagaland, India, elected members of the 60-seat Legislative Assembly. The Indian National Congress won the most seats.

zh.t: 印度那加兰邦举行议会选举
zh.s: 1993年2月15日，印度那加兰邦举行议会选举，选出60个议席的议员。印度国民大会党赢得最多席位。

en.s: On February 15, 1995, a deadly fire broke out in the Weierkang Club (alternatively translated as the Welcome Bar), a Western-style restaurant and karaoke bar in West District, Taichung, Taiwan. The fire killed 64 people and injured 11, making it the second-deadliest fire in the history of Taiwan after the 1984 Meishan coal mine fire that killed 103.

zh.s: 1995年2月15日，台湾台中市西区的西式餐厅兼卡拉OK场所维尔康俱乐部发生严重火灾。该场所也译作“欢迎酒吧”。火灾造成64人死亡、11人受伤，是台湾史上死亡人数第二多的火灾，仅次于1984年造成103人死亡的梅山煤矿火灾。

en.s: General elections were held in Bangladesh on 15 February 1996. They were boycotted by most opposition parties, and saw voter turnout drop to just 21%. The result was a victory for the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), which won 278 of the 300 directly elected seats. This administration was short-lived, however, only lasting 12 days before the installation of caretaker government and fresh elections held in June.

zh.s: 孟加拉国于1996年2月15日举行大选。大多数反对党抵制选举，投票率降至仅21%。孟加拉国民族主义党获胜，赢得300个直选席位中的278席。不过这届政府仅维持12天，随后看守政府上台，并于6月重新举行选举。

en.t: Long March 3B’s first launch fails, destroying Intelsat 708
en.s: On 15 February 1996, the first Long March 3B launch failed shortly after liftoff from Xichang, China. The rocket struck a hillside near the launch centre, destroying the Intelsat 708 satellite and damaging nearby buildings.
en.n: This uses the local China date; the launch was on February14 in UTC.

zh.t: 长征三号乙首飞失败，国际通信卫星708号损毁
zh.s: 1996年2月15日，长征三号乙火箭在中国西昌首次发射，起飞后不久发生故障，撞上发射中心附近的山坡。国际通信卫星708号随之损毁，附近建筑也遭到破坏。
zh.n: 此条采用中国当地日期；按世界协调时，发射发生在2月14日。

en.s: The 1997 Niue Common Roll by-election was held on February 15, 1997, to fill a vacant common roll seat in the Niue Assembly after the death of Toeono Tongatule. The seat was won by independent Billy Talagi, a former member of the Niue People's Party that defeated Toeono Tongatule's late wife, Tiva Tongatule, and Terry Magaoa Chapman.

zh.s: 1997年2月15日，纽埃举行共同选民席位补选，填补托埃奥诺·汤加图莱去世后留下的议会席位。曾属纽埃人民党的独立候选人比利·塔拉吉，击败蒂瓦·汤加图莱和特里·马高阿·查普曼获胜。原文将蒂瓦写为托埃奥诺已故的妻子，但仍列她为参选者，表述存在矛盾。

en.t: No Way Out of Texas: In Your House
en.s: No Way Out of Texas: In Your House was a 1998 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and presented by Western Union. It was the 20th In Your House event and inaugural No Way Out event. It took place on February 15, 1998, at the Compaq Center in Houston, Texas. Seven matches were contested at the event.

zh.t: 得克萨斯无路可逃：到你家
zh.s: “得克萨斯无路可逃：到你家”是世界摔角联盟（WWF，今WWE）制作、西联汇款冠名的1998年职业摔角按次付费赛事。这是第20场“到你家”赛事，也是首场“无路可逃”赛事，于1998年2月15日在美国得克萨斯州休斯敦康柏中心举行，共进行七场比赛。

en.s: The 1998 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match to determine the winners of the 1998 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The match was held at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles, United States, on February 15, 1998, and was contested by the winners of the semi-finals, the United States and Mexico.

zh.t: 1998年中北美及加勒比金杯赛决赛
zh.s: 1998年中北美及加勒比金杯赛决赛于2月15日在美国洛杉矶纪念体育场举行，由半决赛胜出的美国队和墨西哥队争夺冠军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 8 February 1998, with a second round on 15 February. The result was a victory for Glafcos Clerides of the Democratic Rally after he finished as runner-up behind Georgios Iacovou (who was supported by AKEL and the Democratic Party) in the first round. Voter turnout was 92% in the first round and 93% in the second.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于1998年2月8日举行总统选举，并于2月15日举行第二轮投票。民主大会党候选人格拉夫科斯·克莱里季斯获胜；他在首轮投票中排名第二，落后于得到劳动人民进步党和民主党支持的乔治奥斯·伊亚库沃。首轮和第二轮投票率分别为92%和93%。

en.s: The 1999 Nunavut general election was the first general election in the territory and was held on February 15, 1999, to elect the members of the 1st Legislative Assembly of Nunavut. Although Nunavut did not become a territory until April 1, 1999, the election was held early to enable the members to assume their duties on that date.

zh.s: 努纳武特地区于1999年2月15日举行首次地区选举，选出第一届努纳武特立法议会议员。努纳武特直到1999年4月1日才正式成为地区，因此选举提前举行，以便议员届时就任。

en.s: Operation Valiancy (Filipino: Oplan Kagitingan) was the initial military operation of the 2000 Philippine campaign against the Moro Islamic Liberation Front which took place in Maguindanao (before the province's division), Philippines. The Philippine Army, primarily units of its 6th Infantry Division, assaulted Moro Islamic Liberation Front forces in the Talayan-Shariff Aguak-Datu Piang area of Maguindanao and captured Camp Omar ibn al-Khattab, its third largest camp located there.

zh.s: “英勇”行动（菲律宾语：Oplan Kagitingan）是菲律宾军方在2000年针对摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线发起的军事行动，行动地点位于马京达瑙（该省后来分拆）。菲律宾陆军主要调动第6步兵师部队，进攻塔拉扬—谢里夫阿瓜克—达图皮昂一带的摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线武装，并攻占了该组织在当地第三大的营地奥马尔·伊本·哈塔卜营地。

en.s: No Way Out (2004) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on February 15, 2004, at the Cow Palace in San Francisco, California. It was presented by THQ's MX Unleashed. It was the sixth event produced under the No Way Out name and starred wrestlers from the SmackDown! brand. In the main event, Eddie Guerrero defeated WWE Champion Brock Lesnar to win the title - his sole World Championship before his death in 2005. On the undercard Kurt Angle defeated The Big Show and John Cena in a Triple Threat match to earn a title match for the WWE Championship at WrestleMania XX.

zh.s: 2004年无路可逃是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2月15日在美国加利福尼亚州旧金山牛宫举行，由THQ游戏《MX Unleashed》冠名。这是第六届同名赛事，由SmackDown!品牌选手参赛。主赛中，埃迪·格雷罗击败WWE冠军布洛克·莱斯纳，夺得他在2005年去世前唯一一次世界冠军。另一场比赛中，科特·安格在三人威胁赛中击败大秀哥及约翰·塞纳，获得在第20届摔角狂热大赛挑战WWE冠军的资格。

en.s: The 54th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from 5–15 February 2004. The festival opened with out of competition film Cold Mountain by Anthony Minghella. 25 Degrees in Winter by Stéphane Vuillet served as the closing film. The Golden Bear was awarded to Head-On directed by Fatih Akın. The retrospective dedicated to films from 1967 to 1976 titled New Hollywood 1967-1976.

zh.s: 第54届柏林国际电影节于2004年2月5日至15日举行。电影节以安东尼·明格拉执导、非竞赛展映的《冷山》开幕，闭幕片是斯特凡·维耶的《冬日25度》。法提赫·阿金执导的《勇往直前》获得金熊奖。电影节还举办了名为“新好莱坞1967—1976”的回顾展。

en.s: Operation Shurta Nasir or Operation Police Victory or the Battle of Hīt was an operation led by U.S. troops and Iraqi SWAT teams trying to capture the town of Hīt from Islamic State of Iraq forces. The goal of the mission was to eject the Islamic State of Iraq from the city and establish three police stations there to cement authority in the town.

zh.s: “警察胜利”行动（又称希特战役）由美国军队和伊拉克特警队实施，目标是从伊拉克伊斯兰国手中夺回希特镇，并在当地设立三处警察局以巩固管辖。

en.s: No Way Out (2009) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) and was presented by AT&T. It took place on February 15, 2009, at the KeyArena in Seattle, Washington. It was the eleventh event under the No Way Out name and featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown and ECW brands. en.s: The Halle train collision (also known as the Buizingen train collision) was a collision between two NMBS/SNCB passenger trains carrying a combined 250 to 300 people in Buizingen, in the municipality of Halle, Flemish Brabant, Belgium, on 15 February 2010. The crash occurred in snowy conditions at 08:28 CET (07:28 UTC), during rush hour, on railway line 96 (Brussels–Quévy) about 12 kilometres (7.5 mi) from Brussels between P-train E3678 from Leuven to Braine-le-Comte (a local rush hour train) and IC-train E1707 from Quiévrain to Liège (an intercity train).

zh.s: 2010年2月15日，两列比利时国家铁路公司（NMBS/SNCB）客运列车在比利时佛兰德斯布拉班特省哈勒市的布伊津根相撞，车上乘客合计约250至300人。事故发生时正值早高峰，天气下雪，时间为欧洲中部时间08:28（协调世界时07:28），地点在96号铁路线上，距布鲁塞尔约12公里（7.5英里）。相撞列车分别是从鲁汶开往布赖讷勒孔特的本地高峰列车E3678，以及从基耶夫兰开往列日的城际列车E1707。

en.s: The Comayagua prison fire was a deadly fire that occurred 14/15 February 2012 at the National Penitentiary in Comayagua, Honduras, killing 360 people. Among the dead were the spouses of inmates on conjugal visits. Prisoners trapped in their cells died by burning or suffocation; dozens were burned beyond recognition. The fire in the prison started late in the evening of 14 February. According to one prisoner, calls for help went out almost immediately and "for a while, nobody listened. But after a few minutes, which seemed like an eternity, a guard appeared with keys and let us out."

en.s: An African Union (AU) Commission Chairperson election was held in February 2025 to choose the fifth Commission Chair to succeed Chairperson Moussa Faki. On 15 February 2025, Djibouti's Mahamoud Ali Youssouf was elected with 33 votes in the seventh round of voting. He was inaugurated on 13 March.

zh.t: 2025年非洲联盟委员会主席选举
zh.s: 非洲联盟（AU）于2025年2月举行委员会主席选举，选出第五任主席，接替穆萨·法基。2月15日，吉布提的马哈茂德·阿里·优素福在第七轮投票中获得33票，当选主席。他于3月13日就职。

en.s: The 40th Santa Barbara International Film Festival, is the 2025 edition of the Santa Barbara International Film Festival, which took place from February 4 to February 15, 2025, at Santa Barbara, California, United States. In October November and December 2024, honorary awards were announced which are: Outstanding Performer of the Year Award for Ralph Fiennes; Kirk Douglas Award For Excellence In Film for Will Ferrell; Maltin Modern Master Award for Angelina Jolie and Arlington Artist Of The Year Award for Timothée Chalamet.

zh.t: 第40届圣巴巴拉国际电影节
zh.s: 第40届圣巴巴拉国际电影节于2025年2月4日至15日在美国加利福尼亚州圣巴巴拉举行。2024年10月至12月间，电影节公布了多项荣誉奖：拉尔夫·费因斯获年度杰出演员奖，威尔·法瑞尔获柯克·道格拉斯卓越奖，安吉丽娜·朱莉获马尔汀现代大师奖，提莫西·查拉梅获阿灵顿年度艺术家奖。
